description: Part 2 of the conversational Mandarin recall series, scaffolded: vocabulary in batches of at most ten, each word used in a sentence right away and again later; topics (food, tea, jiu jitsu, background, work, hobbies) split in halves and alternated; every sentence adds at most one new word. Gray subtext explains measure words, grammar patterns and confusable characters. Assumes Part 1 (Recall Conversational Chinese — 500) is fully learned. Study in order: in deck options set New card gather order = Ascending position and New card sort order = Order gathered.

cards.front: dish / cuisine (a plate of food, or a country's food)

cards.back:
这道菜 (zhè dào cài)
道 (dào) is the measure word for dishes: 一道菜 = one dish.
这道菜很辣。(Zhè dào cài hěn là.)
这道菜辣吗？(Zhè dào cài là ma?)
这道菜太咸了。(Zhè dào cài tài xián le.)
汤太咸了。(Tāng tài xián le.)

cards.front: a bit / kind of (before an adjective, usually a complaint)
cards.back:
有点 (yǒudiǎn)
有点 + adjective: 有点咸 = a bit salty. Not the same as 一点 (a little bit of something).

cards.front: This dish is a bit oily.
cards.back: 这道菜有点油腻。(Zhè dào cài yǒudiǎn yóunì.)
这个味道太好了。(Zhège wèidào tài hǎo le.)
这是牛肉吗？(Zhè shì niúròu ma?)
我想吃豆腐。(Wǒ xiǎng chī dòufu.)
我对海鲜过敏。(Wǒ duì hǎixiān guòmǐn.)

cards.front: Is there meat in this dish?
cards.back: 这道菜有肉吗？(Zhè dào cài yǒu ròu ma?)

cards.front: to put in / to add (an ingredient)

cards.back: 汤不够热。(Tāng bú gòu rè.)

cards.front: Can you make it less oily?
cards.back:
可以少放一点油吗？(Kěyǐ shǎo fàng yīdiǎn yóu ma?)
Literally: can you put in a bit less oil?
请不要放味精。(Qǐng bú yào fàng wèijīng.)

cards.front: Could you add a bit more salt?
cards.back: 可以多加一点盐吗？(Kěyǐ duō jiā yīdiǎn yán ma?)
可以再加一点米饭吗？(Kěyǐ zài jiā yīdiǎn mǐfàn ma?)

辣的 (là de)
adjective + 的 = 'the ... kind': 辣的 = spicy stuff, 甜的 = sweet stuff.
我很喜欢吃辣的。(Wǒ hěn xǐhuān chī là de.)
我很爱吃甜的。(Wǒ hěn ài chī tián de.)

cards.front: This dish is a bit sweet.
cards.back: 这道菜有点甜。(Zhè dào cài yǒudiǎn tián.)
我很爱吃牛肉。(Wǒ hěn ài chī niúròu.)

cards.front: inside (short form, placed after a noun)

cards.back: 我不吃猪肉。(Wǒ bù chī zhūròu.)
我很少吃甜食。(Wǒ hěn shǎo chī tiánshí.)
除了牛肉，我什么都吃。(Chúle niúròu, wǒ shénme dōu chī.)
这道菜里有什么？(Zhè dào cài lǐ yǒu shénme?)
我最喜欢吃牛肉。(Wǒ zuì xǐhuān chī niúròu.)

这是我最喜欢的菜。(Zhè shì wǒ zuì xǐhuān de cài.)
最喜欢的 = favorite
今天有什么特色菜？(Jīntiān yǒu shénme tèsè cài?)

cards.front: I want to try a local dish.
cards.back: 我想尝一道本地菜。(Wǒ xiǎng cháng yī dào běndì cài.)

你要尝一口吗？(Nǐ yào cháng yī kǒu ma?)
一口 = one bite / one mouthful
我尝一口。(Wǒ cháng yī kǒu.)

cards.front: to serve food (bring dishes to the table)
cool / cold (of food that has cooled down)
The food came out really fast.
cards.back: 上菜很快。(Shàng cài hěn kuài.)

cards.front: I want to take this home.
cards.back:
这个我想带回家。(Zhège wǒ xiǎng dài huí jiā.)
带回家 = take home
可以加热一下吗？(Kěyǐ jiārè yīxià ma?)

菜要凉了。(Cài yào liáng le.)
要...了 = about to

cards.front: Let's order a few dishes and share.
cards.back:
我们点几个菜大家一起吃。(Wǒmen diǎn jǐ gè cài dàjiā yīqǐ chī.)
几个 = a few
你要甜点吗？(Nǐ yào tiándiǎn ma?)

cards.front: This soup is a bit salty.
cards.back: 这个汤有点咸。(Zhège tāng yǒudiǎn xián.)
除了海鲜，我什么都吃。(Chúle hǎixiān, wǒ shénme dōu chī.)
我最喜欢吃甜点。(Wǒ zuì xǐhuān chī tiándiǎn.)

cards.front: cup (also the measure word for cups of something)

cards.back: 我很喜欢喝茶。(Wǒ hěn xǐhuān hē chá.)
我每天都喝茶。(Wǒ měitiān dōu hē chá.)

cards.front: I drink tea in the morning.
cards.back: 我早上喝茶。(Wǒ zǎoshang hē chá.)
我喝茶，不喝咖啡。(Wǒ hē chá, bù hē kāfēi.)
你推荐什么茶？(Nǐ tuījiàn shénme chá?)

cards.front: This tea has a wonderful aroma.
cards.back: 这茶很香。(Zhè chá hěn xiāng.)

cards.front: This tea is a bit light.
cards.back: 这茶有点淡。(Zhè chá yǒudiǎn dàn.)
再来一杯茶。(Zài lái yī bēi chá.)

cards.front: Can I have some hot water?
cards.back: 可以加一点开水吗？(Kěyǐ jiā yīdiǎn kāishuǐ ma?)

cards.front: These tea leaves are very fragrant.
cards.back: 这茶叶很香。(Zhè cháyè hěn xiāng.)

我比较喜欢乌龙茶。(Wǒ bǐjiào xǐhuān wūlóng chá.)
比较喜欢 = prefer (lit. 'relatively like')
你喝过普洱茶吗？(Nǐ hē guò pǔ'ěr chá ma?)
奶茶太甜了。(Nǎichá tài tián le.)

cards.front: No sugar in my tea, please.
cards.back: 我的茶不要糖。(Wǒ de chá bú yào táng.)
我不喜欢甜的茶。(Wǒ bù xǐhuān tián de chá.)
绿茶有咖啡因，对吧？(Lǜchá yǒu kāfēiyīn, duì ba?)

cards.front: I can't drink tea at night.
cards.back: 我晚上不能喝茶。(Wǒ wǎnshang bù néng hē chá.)

cards.front: Let's go to a tea house.
cards.back: 我们去茶馆吧。(Wǒmen qù cháguǎn ba.)

cards.front: How should I brew this tea?
cards.back: 这个茶怎么泡？(Zhège chá zěnme pào?)

cards.front: How long should I steep it?
cards.back: 要泡多久？(Yào pào duō jiǔ?)
可以泡浓一点吗？(Kěyǐ pào nóng yīdiǎn ma?)
这茶壶很漂亮。(Zhè cháhú hěn piàoliang.)

cards.front: Let me pour you some tea.
cards.back: 我给你倒杯茶。(Wǒ gěi nǐ dào bēi chá.)

cards.front: This tea is a bit astringent.
cards.back: 这茶有点涩。(Zhè chá yǒudiǎn sè.)
我妈妈比较喜欢咖啡。(Wǒ māma bǐjiào xǐhuān kāfēi.)

cards.front: Do you want a cup of tea?
cards.back: 你要一杯茶吗？(Nǐ yào yī bēi chá ma?)

cards.front: This tea is a bit expensive but very fragrant.
cards.back: 这茶有点贵，但是很香。(Zhè chá yǒudiǎn guì, dànshì hěn xiāng.)

cards.front: to practice / to train (casual, one syllable)
to attend class / to have class

cards.back: 我练巴西柔术。(Wǒ liàn Bāxī róushù.)
你试过柔术吗？(Nǐ shì guò róushù ma?)

cards.front: I train three times a week.
cards.back:
我一周训练三次。(Wǒ yī zhōu xùnliàn sān cì.)
一周 = one week; 三次 = three times

cards.front: I usually train in the evening.
cards.back: 我一般晚上训练。(Wǒ yībān wǎnshang xùnliàn.)
你一般在哪里训练？(Nǐ yībān zài nǎlǐ xùnliàn?)
我的教练是巴西人。(Wǒ de jiàoliàn shì Bāxī rén.)
我的队友很好。(Wǒ de duìyǒu hěn hǎo.)

cards.front: The gym is close to my home.
cards.back: 道馆离我家很近。(Dàoguǎn lí wǒ jiā hěn jìn.)
今天的课很累。(Jīntiān de kè hěn lèi.)

cards.front: I have class at seven tomorrow.
cards.back: 我明天七点上课。(Wǒ míngtiān qī diǎn shàng kè.)

cards.front: I've trained jiu jitsu for two years.
cards.back: 我练柔术两年了。(Wǒ liàn róushù liǎng nián le.)

你是什么带？(Nǐ shì shénme dài?)
带 is short for 腰带 in belt ranks.

cards.front: My coach is a black belt.
cards.back: 我的教练是黑带。(Wǒ de jiàoliàn shì hēidài.)
今天我们练动作了。(Jīntiān wǒmen liàn dòngzuò le.)
再给我看一次这个动作。(Zài gěi wǒ kàn yī cì zhège dòngzuò.)
我们今天对练了。(Wǒmen jīntiān duìliàn le.)

要不要对练一下？(Yào bú yào duìliàn yīxià?)
要不要 = 'want to or not?', a casual way to ask.

cards.front: I'm taking a break this week.
cards.back: 我这周休息。(Wǒ zhè zhōu xiūxi.)
我昨天受伤了。(Wǒ zuótiān shòushāng le.)

累死了 (lèi sǐ le)
adjective + 死了 = extremely: 累死了, 饿死了.
小心我的膝盖。(Xiǎoxīn wǒ de xīgài.)
我累死了。(Wǒ lèi sǐ le.)
我浑身酸痛。(Wǒ húnshēn suān tòng.)
我忘了呼吸。(Wǒ wàng le hūxī.)

cards.front: You have to warm up before training.
cards.back: 训练以前要热身。(Xùnliàn yǐqián yào rèshēn.)
我肌肉酸痛。(Wǒ jīròu suān tòng.)
上课以后我累死了。(Shàng kè yǐhòu wǒ lèi sǐ le.)
我膝盖有点疼。(Wǒ xīgài yǒudiǎn téng.)
我很少受伤。(Wǒ hěn shǎo shòushāng.)

cards.front: I was born in the US.
cards.back: 我在美国出生。(Wǒ zài Měiguó chūshēng.)

cards.front: I grew up in the US.
cards.back: 我在美国长大。(Wǒ zài Měiguó zhǎng dà.)
我爸爸是希腊人。(Wǒ bàba shì Xīlà rén.)
我妈妈是墨西哥人。(Wǒ māma shì Mòxīgē rén.)
我一半是希腊人，一半是墨西哥人。(Wǒ yībàn shì Xīlà rén, yībàn shì Mòxīgē rén.)
我家有两种文化。(Wǒ jiā yǒu liǎng zhǒng wénhuà.)
我喜欢这两种文化。(Wǒ xǐhuān zhè liǎng zhǒng wénhuà.)

cards.front: My mom and my dad are very different.
cards.back:
我妈妈和我爸爸很不一样。(Wǒ māma hé wǒ bàba hěn bù yīyàng.)
不一样 = different, not the same

cards.front: since childhood / from a young age
Greek and Mexican food are very different.
cards.back: 希腊菜和墨西哥菜很不一样。(Xīlà cài hé Mòxīgē cài hěn bù yīyàng.)
英语是我的母语。(Yīngyǔ shì wǒ de mǔyǔ.)
我会说一点西班牙语。(Wǒ huì shuō yīdiǎn Xībānyá yǔ.)

cards.front: I grew up speaking Spanish at home.
cards.back: 我从小在家说西班牙语。(Wǒ cóngxiǎo zài jiā shuō Xībānyá yǔ.)
我爷爷奶奶是希腊人。(Wǒ yéye nǎinai shì Xīlà rén.)
你应该来我家乡看看。(Nǐ yīnggāi lái wǒ jiāxiāng kànkan.)

我家人感情很好。(Wǒ jiārén gǎnqíng hěn hǎo.)
Literally: my family's bond is very good.
我有一个妹妹。(Wǒ yǒu yīgè mèimei.)

cards.front: We've been together for two years.
cards.back: 我们在一起两年了。(Wǒmen zài yīqǐ liǎng nián le.)
我妈妈那边是墨西哥人。(Wǒ māma nà biān shì Mòxīgē rén.)
我最喜欢吃塔可。(Wǒ zuì xǐhuān chī tǎkě.)
我家是多元文化的。(Wǒ jiā shì duōyuán wénhuà de.)
我很喜欢吃希腊菜。(Wǒ hěn xǐhuān chī Xīlà cài.)
你吃过墨西哥菜吗？(Nǐ chī guò Mòxīgē cài ma?)

cards.front: My grandparents drink tea every day.
cards.back: 我爷爷奶奶每天都喝茶。(Wǒ yéye nǎinai měitiān dōu hē chá.)

cards.front: My partner trains jiu jitsu too.
cards.back: 我的伴侣也练柔术。(Wǒ de bànlǚ yě liàn róushù.)

cards.front: meal / cooked rice (short form, as in 吃饭)

cards.back: 我喜欢做饭。(Wǒ xǐhuān zuò fàn.)
我不太会做饭。(Wǒ bú tài huì zuò fàn.)

这是我自己做的。(Zhè shì wǒ zìjǐ zuò de.)
自己做的 = made by myself

cards.front: Can you teach me this dish?
cards.back: 你能教我这个菜吗？(Nǐ néng jiāo wǒ zhège cài ma?)

cards.front: Next time I'll cook for you.
cards.back: 下次我给你做饭。(Xià cì wǒ gěi nǐ zuò fàn.)
我会炒鸡蛋。(Wǒ huì chǎo jīdàn.)

cards.front: I want to learn to cook Chinese food.
cards.back: 我想学做中国菜。(Wǒ xiǎng xué zuò Zhōngguó cài.)
我很喜欢吃火锅。(Wǒ hěn xǐhuān chī huǒguō.)
你吃过火锅吗？(Nǐ chī guò huǒguō ma?)
这饺子是手工做的。(Zhè jiǎozi shì shǒugōng zuò de.)

饭好了！(Fàn hǎo le!)
Literally: the meal is done.
中国菜种类太多了。(Zhōngguó cài zhǒnglèi tài duō le.)
我喜欢尝试新食物。(Wǒ xǐhuān chángshì xīn shíwù.)
希腊沙拉很清爽。(Xīlà shālā hěn qīngshuǎng.)

cards.front: American food is a bit greasy.
cards.back: 美国菜有点油腻。(Měiguó cài yǒudiǎn yóunì.)
我经常吃鸡肉。(Wǒ jīngcháng chī jīròu.)
你喜欢吃中国菜吗？(Nǐ xǐhuān chī Zhōngguó cài ma?)
我最喜欢吃墨西哥菜。(Wǒ zuì xǐhuān chī Mòxīgē cài.)

cards.front: scallion, ginger and garlic (the classic stir-fry trio)
Stir-frying needs scallion, ginger and garlic.
cards.back: 炒菜要放葱姜蒜。(Chǎo cài yào fàng cōng jiāng suàn.)

cards.front: Add a bit of soy sauce.
I add vinegar when I eat dumplings.
cards.back: 我吃饺子要加醋。(Wǒ chī jiǎozi yào jiā cù.)
蒸鱼很好吃。(Zhēng yú hěn hǎochī.)
烤鸡肉很香。(Kǎo jīròu hěn xiāng.)
我自己做面包。(Wǒ zìjǐ zuò miànbāo.)
我不喝牛奶。(Wǒ bù hē niúnǎi.)

cards.front: I cook food from both cultures.
cards.back: 我做两种文化的菜。(Wǒ zuò liǎng zhǒng wénhuà de cài.)

cards.front: My mom taught me to cook.
cards.back: 我妈妈教我做饭。(Wǒ māma jiāo wǒ zuò fàn.)

cards.front: I want to try the steamed fish.
cards.back: 我想尝尝蒸鱼。(Wǒ xiǎng chángchang zhēng yú.)

cards.front: This dish is a bit sour.
cards.back: 这道菜有点酸。(Zhè dào cài yǒudiǎn suān.)

cards.front: tea ceremony / the way of tea
to produce (grown / made in a place)

cards.back:
种 (zhòng)
Same character as 种 zhǒng (kind), different tone: 两种茶 = two kinds of tea; 种茶 = to grow tea.
我在学茶道。(Wǒ zài xué chádào.)
茶文化很有意思。(Chá wénhuà hěn yǒuyìsi.)
这是高山乌龙茶。(Zhè shì gāoshān wūlóng chá.)

这茶是哪里产的？(Zhè chá shì nǎlǐ chǎn de?)
Literally: where is this tea produced?
这茶是台湾的。(Zhè chá shì Táiwān de.)

cards.front: I want to visit a tea plantation.
cards.back: 我想去茶园看看。(Wǒ xiǎng qù cháyuán kànkan.)

cards.front: It's grown by the tea farmers themselves.
cards.back: 这是茶农自己种的。(Zhè shì chánóng zìjǐ zhòng de.)

cards.front: to pair with / to go with

cards.back: 我买了一些散茶。(Wǒ mǎi le yīxiē sǎnchá.)

cards.front: I prefer loose-leaf over tea bags.
cards.back: 我喜欢散茶，不喜欢茶包。(Wǒ xǐhuān sǎnchá, bù xǐhuān chábāo.)
老普洱茶比较贵。(Lǎo pǔ'ěr chá bǐjiào guì.)

cards.front: This tea is hard to find.
cards.back: 这茶很难找。(Zhè chá hěn nán zhǎo.)

cards.front: This tea has been aged a long time.
cards.back:
这茶放了很久。(Zhè chá fàng le hěn jiǔ.)
放 here = left to sit / stored

cards.front: This tea pairs well with desserts.
cards.back: 这茶配甜点很合适。(Zhè chá pèi tiándiǎn hěn héshì.)

cards.front: Tea is good for your health.
cards.back:
喝茶对身体好。(Hē chá duì shēntǐ hǎo.)
对...好 = good for
喝茶让我放松。(Hē chá ràng wǒ fàngsōng.)

泡茶是一门艺术。(Pào chá shì yī mén yìshù.)
门 is the measure word for arts and subjects.

cards.front: I want to try authentic Chinese tea.
cards.back: 我想喝正宗的中国茶。(Wǒ xiǎng hē zhèngzōng de Zhōngguó chá.)

cards.front: Yunnan is famous for pu'er tea.
cards.back: 云南的普洱茶很有名。(Yúnnán de pǔ'ěr chá hěn yǒumíng.)

cards.front: This oolong has a floral aroma.
cards.back: 这乌龙茶有花香。(Zhè wūlóng chá yǒu huāxiāng.)
老普洱茶很醇厚。(Lǎo pǔ'ěr chá hěn chúnhòu.)

cards.front: I want to try a new kind of tea.
cards.back:
我想试一种新茶。(Wǒ xiǎng shì yī zhǒng xīnchá.)
一种 = one kind of

cards.front: I'll have a cup of tea and relax.
cards.back: 我喝一杯茶放松一下。(Wǒ hē yī bēi chá fàngsōng yīxià.)

cards.front: Let's go drink tea at a tea house.
cards.back: 我们去茶馆喝茶吧。(Wǒmen qù cháguǎn hē chá ba.)
台湾的乌龙茶很有名。(Táiwān de wūlóng chá hěn yǒumíng.)
他降服了我。(Tā xiángfú le wǒ.)

cards.front: He caught me in a triangle.
cards.back: 他用三角绞降服了我。(Tā yòng sānjiǎo jiǎo xiángfú le wǒ.)

cards.front: I submitted a black belt today!
cards.back: 我今天降服了一个黑带！(Wǒ jīntiān xiángfú le yīgè hēidài!)
我从骑乘位逃出来了。(Wǒ cóng qíchéng wèi táo chū lái le.)

我过了他的防守。(Wǒ guò le tā de fángshǒu.)
过 here = to get past (guò), not the 'have done before' 过.
我很喜欢侧位。(Wǒ hěn xǐhuān cè wèi.)
我在练摔法。(Wǒ zài liàn shuāifǎ.)

cards.front: strong point / strength (what you're best at)

cards.back: 我最喜欢十字固。(Wǒ zuì xǐhuān shízì gù.)

cards.front: He got me with a rear naked choke.
cards.back: 他用裸绞降服了我。(Tā yòng luǒ jiǎo xiángfú le wǒ.)
我的对手很重。(Wǒ de duìshǒu hěn zhòng.)
防守是我的强项。(Fángshǒu shì wǒ de qiángxiàng.)

cards.front: I want to improve my technique.
cards.back: 我想提高技术。(Wǒ xiǎng tígāo jìshù.)

他比我大。(Tā bǐ wǒ dà.)
A 比 B + adjective = A is more ... than B
他比我大很多。(Tā bǐ wǒ dà hěn duō.)

技术比力量重要。(Jìshù bǐ lìliàng zhòngyào.)
Literally: technique is more important than strength.

cards.front: Size doesn't matter in jiu jitsu.
cards.back:
柔术不看体型。(Róushù bú kàn tǐxíng.)
Literally: jiu jitsu doesn't look at build.
保持冷静，呼吸。(Bǎochí lěngjìng, hūxī.)
用你的胯。(Yòng nǐ de kuà.)
别太用力。(Bié tài yòng lì.)

得 (dé)
dé = to get. The same character is de after a verb (说得对) and děi = must.

cards.front: I don't quite get this move.
cards.back: 这个动作我不太懂。(Zhège dòngzuò wǒ bú tài dǒng.)
可以慢慢解释吗？(Kěyǐ mànman jiěshì ma?)

在我身上试一下。(Zài wǒ shēn shàng shì yīxià.)
身上 = on the body
我下个月要比赛。(Wǒ xià gè yuè yào bǐsài.)
这周末有比赛。(Zhè zhōumò yǒu bǐsài.)
我赢了比赛。(Wǒ yíng le bǐsài.)
我在我的级别赢了。(Wǒ zài wǒ de jíbié yíng le.)
我得了金牌。(Wǒ dé le jīnpái.)

这项运动 (zhè xiàng yùndòng)
运动 = sport / exercise; 项 is its measure word.
我决赛输了。(Wǒ juésài shū le.)

cards.front: Jiu jitsu has changed my life.
cards.back: 柔术改变了我的生活。(Róushù gǎibiàn le wǒ de shēnghuó.)
我很喜欢这项运动。(Wǒ hěn xǐhuān zhè xiàng yùndòng.)
这个圈子很好。(Zhège quānzi hěn hǎo.)

我的队友像家人一样。(Wǒ de duìyǒu xiàng jiārén yīyàng.)
像...一样 = just like ...

cards.front: Jiu jitsu is like a chess game.
cards.back:
柔术就像下棋。(Róushù jiù xiàng xià qí.)
就像 = is just like
谁都可以练柔术。(Shéi dōu kěyǐ liàn róushù.)

cards.front: a class (节 = measure word for classes)
Do you train with a gi?
cards.back: 你穿道服训练吗？(Nǐ chuān dàofú xùnliàn ma?)
我比较喜欢不穿道服训练。(Wǒ bǐjiào xǐhuān bù chuān dàofú xùnliàn.)
想来试一节课吗？(Xiǎng lái shì yī jié kè ma?)

cards.front: I still have so much to learn.
cards.back:
我还有很多要学的。(Wǒ hái yǒu hěn duō yào xué de.)
要学的 = things to learn

cards.front: My coach says technique is the most important.
cards.back: 我的教练说技术最重要。(Wǒ de jiàoliàn shuō jìshù zuì zhòngyào.)

cards.front: After competing I rest for a week.
cards.back: 比赛以后我休息一周。(Bǐsài yǐhòu wǒ xiūxi yī zhōu.)

cards.front: My teammate got the gold medal.
cards.back: 我的队友得了金牌。(Wǒ de duìyǒu dé le jīnpái.)

cards.front: My opponent is heavier than me.
cards.back: 我的对手比我重。(Wǒ de duìshǒu bǐ wǒ zhòng.)

cards.front: to study (for a degree) / to read

cards.back: 我在学临床社会工作。(Wǒ zài xué línchuáng shèhuì gōngzuò.)
我的专业是社会工作。(Wǒ de zhuānyè shì shèhuì gōngzuò.)
我在读硕士。(Wǒ zài dú shuòshì.)

cards.front: I want to become a therapist.
cards.back: 我想做心理咨询师。(Wǒ xiǎng zuò xīnlǐ zīxún shī.)
心理健康很重要。(Xīnlǐ jiànkāng hěn zhòngyào.)
我现在在实习。(Wǒ xiànzài zài shíxí.)
我在诊所实习。(Wǒ zài zhěnsuǒ shíxí.)
我的来访者是成年人。(Wǒ de láifǎngzhě shì chéngnián rén.)
我想帮助别人。(Wǒ xiǎng bāngzhù biérén.)
很多人需要帮助。(Hěn duō rén xūyào bāngzhù.)
我很喜欢我的工作。(Wǒ hěn xǐhuān wǒ de gōngzuò.)

cards.front: to be interested in (对 + thing + 感兴趣)

cards.back: 我也是软件工程师。(Wǒ yě shì ruǎnjiàn gōngchéngshī.)
我每天写代码。(Wǒ měitiān xiě dàimǎ.)

cards.front: Coding and therapy are very different.
cards.back: 编程和心理咨询很不一样。(Biānchéng hé xīnlǐ zīxún hěn bù yīyàng.)
我对人工智能感兴趣。(Wǒ duì réngōng zhìnéng gǎn xìngqù.)
我的公司是远程的。(Wǒ de gōngsī shì yuǎnchéng de.)
我在家工作。(Wǒ zài jiā gōngzuò.)
我在科技行业工作。(Wǒ zài kējì hángyè gōngzuò.)
科技变化很快。(Kējì biànhuà hěn kuài.)

两份工作 (liǎng fèn gōngzuò)
份 is the measure word for jobs.

得 (děi)
děi, not dé: 我得走了 = I have to go.

cards.front: when ... / at the time of ... (goes after the clause)
in order to / for the sake of

cards.back: 我有两份工作。(Wǒ yǒu liǎng fèn gōngzuò.)
我做全职工作。(Wǒ zuò quánzhí gōngzuò.)
我做兼职工作。(Wǒ zuò jiānzhí gōngzuò.)

cards.front: I do both at the same time.
cards.back: 我同时做两份工作。(Wǒ tóngshí zuò liǎng fèn gōngzuò.)
我一直很忙。(Wǒ yīzhí hěn máng.)
这挺多的。(Zhè tǐng duō de.)

cards.front: But I love what I do.
cards.back: 但我喜欢我做的事。(Dàn wǒ xǐhuān wǒ zuò de shì.)

cards.front: I have to keep learning new things.
cards.back: 我得一直学新东西。(Wǒ děi yīzhí xué xīn dōngxi.)

cards.front: I use AI when I work.
cards.back: 我工作的时候用人工智能。(Wǒ gōngzuò de shíhou yòng réngōng zhìnéng.)

cards.front: But both are for helping people.
cards.back: 但都是为了帮助别人。(Dàn dōu shì wèile bāngzhù biérén.)

cards.front: I want to combine the two.
cards.back: 我想把两个结合在一起。(Wǒ xiǎng bǎ liǎng gè jiéhé zài yīqǐ.)
这是我长远的目标。(Zhè shì wǒ chángyuǎn de mùbiāo.)

cards.front: I speak a bit of Greek.
cards.back: 我会说一点希腊语。(Wǒ huì shuō yīdiǎn Xīlà yǔ.)
我会说三种语言。(Wǒ huì shuō sān zhǒng yǔyán.)
我妈妈是移民。(Wǒ māma shì yímín.)
我家有很多传统。(Wǒ jiā yǒu hěn duō chuántǒng.)
我很忙，但是很高兴。(Wǒ hěn máng, dànshì hěn gāoxìng.)

cards.front: After graduating I want to work at a clinic.
cards.back: 毕业以后我想在诊所工作。(Bìyè yǐhòu wǒ xiǎng zài zhěnsuǒ gōngzuò.)

cards.front: My partner also works from home.
cards.back: 我的伴侣也在家工作。(Wǒ de bànlǚ yě zài jiā gōngzuò.)

cards.front: learn while watching (边 A 边 B = do B while doing A)
cards.back: 边看边学 (biān kàn biān xué)

cards.front: finished (after a verb: 吃完 = finish eating)
My hobbies are tea, food, and jiu jitsu.
cards.back: 我的爱好是茶、美食和柔术。(Wǒ de àihào shì chá, měishí hé róushù.)
你有什么爱好？(Nǐ yǒu shénme àihào?)

cards.front: What do you do in your free time?
cards.back: 你有空的时候做什么？(Nǐ yǒu kòng de shíhou zuò shénme?)

cards.front: I have a lot of interests.
cards.back: 我兴趣很多。(Wǒ xìngqù hěn duō.)
我喜欢尝试新事物。(Wǒ xǐhuān chángshì xīn shìwù.)
做饭让我放松。(Zuò fàn ràng wǒ fàngsōng.)

我压力大的时候做饭。(Wǒ yālì dà de shíhou zuò fàn.)
压力大 = stressed (lit. pressure is big)
喝茶让我专心。(Hē chá ràng wǒ zhuānxīn.)

cards.front: I drink tea while I code.
cards.back: 我边写代码边喝茶。(Wǒ biān xiě dàimǎ biān hē chá.)

训练完我很饿。(Xùnliàn wán wǒ hěn è.)
训练完 = after training (lit. training finished)

cards.front: After training, I drink lots of water.
cards.back: 训练完我喝很多水。(Xùnliàn wán wǒ hē hěn duō shuǐ.)

cards.front: Tea is great after a workout.
cards.back: 训练完喝茶很舒服。(Xùnliàn wán hē chá hěn shūfu.)

cards.front: a book (本 = measure word for books)
Jiu jitsu is my main exercise.
cards.back: 柔术是我主要的运动。(Róushù shì wǒ zhǔyào de yùndòng.)
我很少做别的运动。(Wǒ hěn shǎo zuò bié de yùndòng.)
我有时候举重。(Wǒ yǒu shíhou jǔzhòng.)
我应该多拉伸。(Wǒ yīnggāi duō lāshēn.)
我骑车去道馆。(Wǒ qí chē qù dàoguǎn.)
我想开始冥想。(Wǒ xiǎng kāishǐ míngxiǎng.)
喝茶很像冥想。(Hē chá hěn xiàng míngxiǎng.)

cards.front: I read books about mental health.
cards.back: 我读心理健康的书。(Wǒ dú xīnlǐ jiànkāng de shū.)
我在读一本中文书。(Wǒ zài dú yī běn Zhōngwén shū.)

cards.front: for me / as far as I'm concerned
cards.back: 对我来说 (duì wǒ lái shuō)
我每天练中文。(Wǒ měitiān liàn Zhōngwén.)

cards.front: I want to speak fluent Chinese.
cards.back: 我想说流利的中文。(Wǒ xiǎng shuō liúlì de Zhōngwén.)
学中文挺难的。(Xué Zhōngwén tǐng nán de.)
但我喜欢挑战。(Dàn wǒ xǐhuān tiǎozhàn.)
声调对我来说很难。(Shēngdiào duì wǒ lái shuō hěn nán.)

cards.front: I forget characters all the time.
cards.back: 我老是忘汉字。(Wǒ lǎoshì wàng hànzì.)

cards.front: Writing characters is the hardest part.
cards.back: 写汉字最难。(Xiě hànzì zuì nán.)

cards.front: I learn from my Chinese friends.
cards.back: 我从中国朋友那里学。(Wǒ cóng Zhōngguó péngyou nàlǐ xué.)

cards.front: Want to do a language exchange with me?
cards.back: 你想跟我做语言交换吗？(Nǐ xiǎng gēn wǒ zuò yǔyán jiāohuàn ma?)
我可以教你英语。(Wǒ kěyǐ jiāo nǐ Yīngyǔ.)
或者西班牙语也行。(Huòzhě Xībānyá yǔ yě xíng.)
我边喝茶边读书。(Wǒ biān hē chá biān dú shū.)
冥想让我放松。(Míngxiǎng ràng wǒ fàngsōng.)

cards.front: My hobbies are all a bit expensive.
cards.back: 我的爱好都有点贵。(Wǒ de àihào dōu yǒudiǎn guì.)

疫情期间 (yìqíng qījiān)
疫情 = pandemic; 期间 = during (a period)
我们找时间见面吧。(Wǒmen zhǎo shíjiān jiànmiàn ba.)

cards.front: I'd love to introduce you to my friends.
cards.back: 我想介绍你认识我的朋友。(Wǒ xiǎng jièshào nǐ rènshi wǒ de péngyou.)

他们人都很好。(Tāmen rén dōu hěn hǎo.)
Literally: as people they're all very good.
我们之后可以一起吃饭。(Wǒmen zhīhòu kěyǐ yīqǐ chīfàn.)

cards.front: Want to come watch me train?
cards.back: 你想来看我训练吗？(Nǐ xiǎng lái kàn wǒ xùnliàn ma?)

我去给我队友加油。(Wǒ qù gěi wǒ duìyǒu jiāyóu.)
给 + person + 加油 = cheer someone on
你要一起去吗？(Nǐ yào yīqǐ qù ma?)
你最喜欢哪个国家的菜？(Nǐ zuì xǐhuān nǎge guójiā de cài?)

cards.front: Are you a tea or coffee person?
cards.back:
你喜欢茶还是咖啡？(Nǐ xǐhuān chá háishi kāfēi?)
还是 = or, only in questions; 或者 = or, in statements.
我是喝茶的。(Wǒ shì hē chá de.)

cards.front: Coffee is too strong for me.
cards.back: 咖啡对我来说太浓了。(Kāfēi duì wǒ lái shuō tài nóng le.)
我很少喝酒。(Wǒ hěn shǎo hē jiǔ.)
我比较喜欢茶或者水。(Wǒ bǐjiào xǐhuān chá huòzhě shuǐ.)

cards.front: I've been into tea for a few years.
cards.back: 我喝茶几年了。(Wǒ hē chá jǐ nián le.)

cards.front: I started drinking tea during the pandemic.
cards.back: 我是疫情期间开始喝茶的。(Wǒ shì yìqíng qījiān kāishǐ hē chá de.)
这成了我每天的习惯。(Zhè chéng le wǒ měitiān de xíguàn.)
你去过美国吗？(Nǐ qù guò Měiguó ma?)
你去过希腊吗？(Nǐ qù guò Xīlà ma?)

cards.front: I want to visit China someday.
cards.back: 我以后想去中国。(Wǒ yǐhòu xiǎng qù Zhōngguó.)

cards.front: Where should I visit in China?
cards.back: 在中国应该去哪里？(Zài Zhōngguó yīnggāi qù nǎlǐ?)

cards.front: I hear Hangzhou's Longjing is great.
cards.back: 听说杭州的龙井很好。(Tīngshuō Hángzhōu de Lóngjǐng hěn hǎo.)

cards.front: I judge tea quality by the leaves.
cards.back: 我看茶叶判断质量。(Wǒ kàn cháyè pànduàn zhìliàng.)
茶叶应该是完整的。(Cháyè yīnggāi shì wánzhěng de.)
香气应该是自然的。(Xiāngqì yīnggāi shì zìrán de.)
回甘应该是甜的。(Huígān yīnggāi shì tián de.)

cards.front: Have you been to a teahouse in Chengdu?
cards.back: 你去过成都的茶馆吗？(Nǐ qù guò Chéngdū de cháguǎn ma?)

cards.front: Sometimes I drink tea before bed.
cards.back: 我有时候睡前喝茶。(Wǒ yǒu shíhou shuì qián hē chá.)

cards.front: I drink tea after a heavy meal.
cards.back: 吃完油腻的饭我喝茶。(Chī wán yóunì de fàn wǒ hē chá.)

cards.front: to learn (and take in): 学 + 到
so / this (degree: 这么好 = this good)
Some teas don't have much caffeine.
cards.back: 有些茶咖啡因不多。(Yǒuxiē chá kāfēiyīn bù duō.)
我总是带保温杯。(Wǒ zǒngshì dài bǎowēn bēi.)
你有什么推荐吗？(Nǐ yǒu shénme tuījiàn ma?)
推荐一个便宜的。(Tuījiàn yīgè piányí de.)
推荐一个特别的。(Tuījiàn yīgè tèbié de.)
我相信你的推荐。(Wǒ xiāngxìn nǐ de tuījiàn.)

cards.front: I really learned a lot today.
cards.back: 我今天学到很多。(Wǒ jīntiān xué dào hěn duō.)
谢谢你这么有耐心。(Xièxie nǐ zhème yǒu nàixīn.)

cards.front: I really enjoy chatting with you.
cards.back: 我很喜欢和你聊天。(Wǒ hěn xǐhuān hé nǐ liáotiān.)

cards.front: I have to head out now.
cards.back: 我要走了。(Wǒ yào zǒu le.)
我要去训练了。(Wǒ yào qù xùnliàn le.)
我要去做饭了。(Wǒ yào qù zuò fàn le.)

cards.front: I'll message you when I'm home.
cards.back: 我到家给你发消息。(Wǒ dào jiā gěi nǐ fā xiāoxi.)
希望我们再见面。(Xīwàng wǒmen zài jiànmiàn.)

cards.front: It was great chatting with you.
cards.back: 跟你聊天很愉快。(Gēn nǐ liáotiān hěn yúkuài.)
